dataset.description: Paper Data availability identifies Jango_ISO_2015 and Chewie_CO_2016 recordings for the isometric and reaching tasks. The public demo supplies only a two-session Day0/Day95 route; authentic complete per-session files, original processing lineage and exact split manifests remain unresolved.

cohort.description: Original isometric panel: Monkey J/Jango, 20 sessions across 95 days and 380 ordered pairs. Original reaching panel: Monkey C/Chewie, 12 sessions across 38 days and 132 ordered pairs. Retain all 512 directed pairs and task-specific outcomes; source human online results are separate claims and are not established by these monkey panels.

split.description: For every original directed pair, preserve reference-day decoder fitting and behavior-hidden target-day neural alignment with held-out behavior scoring. Paper validation reserves 20% in blocks limiting overlap; the two-session demo selects 80% of valid reference trials without a fixed seed. Exact original trial identities, alignment exposure and scoring support are unresolved. A newly chosen split is an extension.

inputs.description: For each original pair, reference-day neural activity and allowed behavior train the latent model/decoder; target-day adaptation receives neural activity without target-day behavior labels. Final target-day force or cursor-velocity labels remain evaluator-owned and cannot influence adaptation or candidate selection.

preprocessing.description: Paper specifies 20-ms bins, channel exclusions/normalization, behavior-outlier handling and 600-ms overlapping training segments. Exact retained channels, filters, event clocks and original masks remain unresolved. Demo movement-onset windows cannot be equated silently to paper target-onset or other analysis windows.

metric.description: Paper Eq. 4 uses variance-weighted multi-output R²: 1 minus summed squared residuals across the original behavior dimensions divided by their summed centered target sums of squares. Preserve force and cursor-velocity target units separately. The paper names sklearn r2_score with multioutput=variance_weighted; pinned Ridge.score uses a different aggregation.

aggregation.description: Compute source variance-weighted R² for each directed session pair, then report separate medians over all 380 isometric pairs and all 132 reaching pairs. The paper does not establish a combined 512-pair median. Figure 2d 0.88 is an illustrated pair and cannot replace either full-panel result. Shared sessions create pair dependence.

full_panel.description: Retain the complete original findings and companions: Figure 2 fixed-Day0 latent projection and Day95 checkpoint trajectories; Figures 3–4 all 380 force and 132 reaching directed pairs for NoMAD, Static decoder, Aligned FA and ADAN, all method-specific within-day anchors, separate whole-panel medians, failures, five-day profiles and original trace products; Figure 5/S10 both original T11 sessions with Static, RTI, NoMAD and NoMAD+RTI, calibration and first evaluation separated from subsequent summaries; S1 readout/no-readout and AutoLFADS; S2–3 causal/acausal inference; S4 decoder lineage; S5 continuous/trial-only FA; S6 stability fits; S7 all eight labels, 304 decreases and 56 contrasts; S8 fixed TNDM; S9 sequential FA; S11 three stitching branches and 12 decoding cells; historical S12 Adaptive LFADS; S13 latency distributions; S14 normalization ablation; S15 Wiener/OLE; S16 complete original dimension sweep. Source-native vectors, missing grids and recording/block joins must be bound before this panel can be admitted; the scalar findings below do not replace those required outputs.
